summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of CG Mushroom e-commerce app. 27/27 backend pytest tests pass covering auth, products, orders (COD full flow including stock decrement/restore on cancel, insufficient-stock 400, razorpay-not-configured 400), admin products/supplies/purchases/analytics, origin guard (403 cross-origin), admin RBAC (401 guest, 403 customer). Frontend smoke-tested on desktop + mobile 390: home hero, shop (search/sort/categories + 7 products), cart drawer add-to-cart, guest /checkout redirect to /login, admin login, admin dashboard KPIs/charts/low-stock/recent-orders, admin orders (8 status selects), admin inventory (7 stock-adjust buttons), admin products, admin purchases, mobile home. EN/HI lang toggle present and switches.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — accessibility warning only, not blocking

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to CartDrawer / dialog components to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py restore_order_stock does not guard against double-restore if an already-cancelled order is cancelled again — currently prevented by status filter in cancel_my_order and the cancelled-check in admin_update_order_status, so logic is safe.
Origin guard middleware correctly enforced; CORS allow_origins list is explicit (good).
Pydantic AddressIn uses min_length=10 on phone and length 6 on pincode — matches requirement.
Analytics purchase_date filter uses string compare; works because ISO date strings sort lexicographically.
All responses already exclude Mongo _id via projections — good.
test_credentials: admin@cgmushroom.in / CGMadmin@2026 — login verified via API and UI.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Shiitake product, TEST_Substrate supply, TEST_Supplier purchases, several TEST_ customer accounts and COD orders during pytest run. Session-scoped fixtures delete the TEST product and supply at teardown. Seeded catalog products untouched. A few TEST_ orders/customers remain in DB (expected — orders are not deleted since model has no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Run: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Admin uses httpOnly cookies via requests.Session. Origin header must be set to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for mutating requests (origin_guard middleware). TODAY variable used for purchase_date so analytics window picks it up.
